sentences.en: Hello and welcome back to my Slow English podcast.
sentences.tc: 你好，歡迎回到我的慢速英語播客。

englishTokens.text: Hello and
welcome back
to my
Slow English podcast

sentences.en: Today we will be reading Swimming by Leo Leone.
sentences.tc: 今天我們将阅讀LeoLeone的《游泳》。

englishTokens.text: Today we will be reading Swimming by Leo Leone.

sentences.en: Read slow English children's books with me.
sentences.tc: 和我一起讀慢速英語童書。

englishTokens.text: Read slow English children's books with me.

sentences.en: A happy school of little red fish lived in a corner of the sea somewhere.
sentences.tc: 在某個海域的某個角落里，住着一群快樂的小红魚。

englishTokens.text: A happy school of little red fish lived in a corner of the sea somewhere.

sentences.en: They were all red.
sentences.tc: 它們都是红色的。

englishTokens.text: They were all red.

sentences.en: Only one of them was black.
sentences.tc: 其中只有一個是黑人。

englishTokens.text: Only one of them was black.

sentences.en: Black as a mussel shell.
sentences.tc: 黑色如贻貝殼。

englishTokens.text: Black as a mussel shell.

sentences.en: He swam faster than his brothers and sisters.
sentences.tc: 他比他的兄弟姐妹游得更快。

englishTokens.text: He swam faster than his brothers and sisters.

sentences.en: His name was Swimmie.
sentences.tc: 他的名字叫斯威米。

englishTokens.text: His name was Swimmie.

sentences.en: One day, a bad tuna fish, swift, fierce, and very hungry, came darting through the waves.
sentences.tc: 有一天，一条坏金枪魚，敏捷、凶猛，而且非常饥饿，在海浪中疾驰而來。

englishTokens.text: One day, a bad tuna fish, swift, fierce, and very hungry, came darting through the waves.

sentences.en: In one gulp, he swallowed all the little red fish.
sentences.tc: 一口氣将小红魚全部吞了下去。

englishTokens.text: In one gulp, he swallowed all the little red fish.

sentences.en: Only Swimmie escaped.
sentences.tc: 只有斯威米逃脱了。

englishTokens.text: Only Swimmie escaped.

sentences.en: He swam away in the deep wet world.
sentences.tc: 他在深濕的世界里游走了。

englishTokens.text: He swam away in the deep wet world.

sentences.en: He was scared, lonely, and very sad.
sentences.tc: 他感到害怕、孤独、非常悲伤。

englishTokens.text: He was scared, lonely, and very sad.

sentences.en: But the sea was full of wonderful creatures.
sentences.tc: 但是大海里充滿了奇妙的生物。

englishTokens.text: But the sea was full of wonderful creatures.

sentences.en: And as he swam from marvel to marvel, Simmyi was happy again.
sentences.tc: 當他从一個奇迹游到另一個奇迹时，西米又感到高興了。

englishTokens.text: And as he swam from marvel to marvel, Simmyi was happy again.

sentences.en: He saw a medusa made of rainbow jelly.
sentences.tc: 他看到了一個由彩虹果冻制成的水母。

englishTokens.text: He saw a medusa made of rainbow jelly.

sentences.en: A lobster who walked about like a watermoving machine.
sentences.tc: 一只像抽水機一樣行走的龍虾。

englishTokens.text: A lobster who walked about like a watermoving machine.

sentences.en: Strange fish pulled by an invisible thread.
sentences.tc: 一条看不见的線拉着的奇怪的魚。

englishTokens.text: Strange fish pulled by an invisible thread.

sentences.en: A forest of seaweeds growing from sugar candy rocks.
sentences.tc: 从糖岩中長出的海藻森林。

englishTokens.text: A forest of seaweeds growing from sugar candy rocks.

sentences.en: An eel whose tail was almost too far away to remember.
sentences.tc: 一条鳗魚，尾巴離得太遠，几乎记不清了。

englishTokens.text: An eel whose tail was almost too far away to remember.

sentences.en: Too far away.
sentences.tc: 太遠了。

englishTokens.text: Too far away.

sentences.en: And sea anemies who looked like pink palm trees swaying in the wind.
sentences.tc: 还有海洋敌人，它們看起來就像在风中摇曳的粉红色棕榈樹。

englishTokens.text: And sea anemies who looked like pink palm trees swaying in the wind.

sentences.en: Then hidden in his dark shade of rocks and weeds, he saw a school of little fish, just like his own.
sentences.tc: 然後，他在岩石和雜草的暗色陰影中看到了一群小魚，就像他自己的魚一樣。

englishTokens.text: Then hidden in his dark shade of rocks and weeds, he saw a school of little fish, just like his own.

sentences.en: Let's go and swim and play and see things.
sentences.tc: 我們去游泳、玩耍、看看东西吧。

englishTokens.text: Let's go and swim and play and see things.

sentences.en: He said happily.
sentences.tc: 他高興地說。

englishTokens.text: He said happily.

sentences.en: We can't, said the little red fish.
sentences.tc: 我們不能，小红魚說。

englishTokens.text: We can't, said the little red fish.

sentences.en: The big fish will eat us.
sentences.tc: 大魚會吃掉我們。

englishTokens.text: The big fish will eat us.

sentences.en: But you can't just lie there, said Swimmie.
sentences.tc: 但你不能只是躺在那里，斯威米說。

englishTokens.text: But you can't just lie there, said Swimmie.

sentences.en: We must think of something.
sentences.tc: 我們必須想点办法。

englishTokens.text: We must think of something.

sentences.en: Swimmie thought and thought and thought.
sentences.tc: Swimmie思考、思考、思考。

englishTokens.text: Swimmie thought and thought and thought.

sentences.en: Then suddenly he said, "I have it.
sentences.tc: 然後他突然說：“我有。

englishTokens.text: Then suddenly he said, "I
have
it.

sentences.en: We are going to swim all together like the biggest fish in the sea.
sentences.tc: 我們要像海里最大的魚一樣一起游泳。

englishTokens.text: We are going to swim all together like the biggest fish in the sea.

sentences.en: He taught them how to swim close together, each in his own place.
sentences.tc: 他教他們如何并肩游泳，每個人都在自己的位置上。

englishTokens.text: He taught them how to swim close together, each in his own place.

sentences.en: And when they had learned to swim like one giant fish, he said, "I'll be the eye."
sentences.tc: 當他們學會像一条大魚一樣游泳时，他說：“我将成為眼睛。”。

englishTokens.text: And when they had learned to swim like one giant fish, he said, "I'll be the eye."

sentences.en: And so they swam in the cool morning water and in the midday sun.
sentences.tc: 于是他們在清晨凉爽的水中和正午的陽光下游泳。

englishTokens.text: And so they swam in the cool morning water and in the midday sun.

sentences.en: And chased the big fish away.
sentences.tc: 并把大魚趕走了。

englishTokens.text: And chased the big fish away.

sentences.en: The end.
sentences.tc: 结束.。

englishTokens.text: The end.

sentences.en: I have a few questions for you.
sentences.tc: 我有几個問题想問你。

englishTokens.text: I
have
a few questions for you.

sentences.en: First one, why do you think Swimmie managed to escape from the big fish?
sentences.tc: 第一，你認為Swimmie為什麼能从大魚手中逃脱？

englishTokens.text: First one, why do you think Swimmie managed to escape from the big fish?

sentences.en: Two.

englishTokens.text: Two.

sentences.en: Was the eel's tail long or short?
sentences.tc: 鳗魚的尾巴是長还是短？

englishTokens.text: Was the eel's tail long or short?

sentences.en: Three, why was swimming the eye when they made the big fish?
sentences.tc: 三、為什麼他們钓大魚的时候​​要游眼睛？

englishTokens.text: Three, why was swimming the eye when they made the big fish?

sentences.en: And four.
sentences.tc: 还有四個。

englishTokens.text: And four.

sentences.en: What do you think the moral of this story is?
sentences.tc: 你認為這個故事的寓意是什麼？

englishTokens.text: What do you think the moral of this story is?

sentences.en: Comment your answers down below.
sentences.tc: 在下面评论你的答案。

englishTokens.text: Comment your answers down below.

sentences.en: I hope you enjoyed my slow English reading.
sentences.tc: 我希望你喜歡我的慢速英語阅讀。

englishTokens.text: I hope you enjoyed my slow English reading.

sentences.en: And if you like these type of videos, then subscribe and like for more.
sentences.tc: 如果您喜歡這些类型的視頻，請訂阅并点讚以获取更多內容。

englishTokens.text: And if you like these type of videos, then subscribe and like for more.

sentences.tc: 這裡是在說：「>>.」。
